headlines.title: She’s delivered 2,000 babies. The measles outbreak changed her mind about vaccines.
headlines.description: Traditional midwives like Roberta Devers could be key to increasing vaccination as outbreaks spread in rural communities such as those in Pennsylvania.

headlines.title: The ‘slam dunk’ that wasn’t: Promising cholesterol drug fails to prevent heart attacks or stroke
headlines.description: An experimental drug that held great promise in driving down a dangerous form of cholesterol didn’t show any measurable impact on heart attack or stroke in a clinical trial.

headlines.title: Muscle health is key to longevity. Here’s how to measure yours.
headlines.description: Body mechanics experts say muscle health is linked to our longevity and how well we fight off disease.

headlines.title: NBC News' Chloe Melas gets candid about gut health in her new book ‘The Girl’s Guide to Guts’
headlines.description: NBC News' Chloe Melas addresses gut health in her new book, ‘The Girl’s Guide to Guts,’ aiming to reduce stigma following her inflammatory bowel disease diagnosis.

headlines.title: Measles cases explode amid declining vaccination rates
headlines.description: NBC News’ Erin McLaughlin traveled to Lancaster County, Pennsylvania, which is the epicenter of a deadly measles outbreak. The investigative report for the NBC News series “The Vaccine Divide” finds 75% of U.S. counties have vaccination rates that are now below the level needed for herd immunity.

headlines.title: World Health Organization officials meet to evaluate revoking the U.S.' measles-free status
headlines.description: U.S. measles cases have surpassed 5,000 cases as officials from the World Heath Organization meet to evaluate the country's measles-free status. NBC News' Erika Edwards discusses how the decline in MMR vaccines administered has contributed to the growth of cases.

headlines.title: Inside the Benefits (and Downsides) of Napping
headlines.description: Taking a short midday snooze can be a good way to recharge and give your brain a boost so Dr. Saema Tahir, a sleep and pulmonary specialist, joins TODAY with everything you need to know, including the biggest mistakes people make when napping.

headlines.title: Can water flossers replace dental floss? Here’s what dentists say
headlines.description: Are water flossers as effective as dental floss? Dentists explain, and share how to properly use them.
